newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil March 24-April 22 Fipe inflation 0.69 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil March 24-April 22 Fipe inflation 0.69 pct.

text.p: Brazil's inflation as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe) was 0.69 percent between March 24 and April 22, up from 0.58 percent in the previous four week period, a Fipe official said.

Juarez Rizzieri, president of the Fipe institute, said a 4.46 percent rise in clothing prices weighed on inflation in the period. He said he expects inflation for the whole of April to be between 0.7 percent and 0.8 percent.
Rizzieri also said recent increases in telephone and electricity rates would only have an impact on the Fipe inflation in May and June.
The Fipe president released the following breakdown of Fipe's weighted inflation index for March 24 through April 22:
- Food: 0.47 pct rise in the period
- Housing: 0.49 pct rise in the period
- Transportation: -0.02 pct drop in the period
- Personal expenses: -0.17 pct drop in the period
- Clothing: 4.46 pct rise in the period
- Health care: 1.10 pct rise in the period
- Education: 0.21 pct rise in the period
The Fipe index is calculated by the University of Sao Paulo, which releases inflation figures weekly.
